title: 축하와 선물: 생일 선물, 어떻게 준비해요?
objective: By the end, you can use 10 words about congratulations and gifts, such as 축하하다, 선물, 포장하다, 꽃 and 카드, in short sentences. You will be able to congratulate someone, ask a shop to gift-wrap something, and talk about choosing and receiving gifts.
summary: Learn 10 everyday Korean words for congratulating people and preparing, wrapping, giving and receiving gifts.

task.title: Use the gift words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, order or answer using the words on page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: I bought a present to give to my friend.

words.meaning: to gift-wrap (in a shop; at a restaurant it means 'to take away')
words.exampleMeaning: It's a gift. Could you wrap it, please?

words.meaning: flowers (a common gift for graduations and birthdays)
words.exampleMeaning: I took flowers to the graduation ceremony.

words.meaning: greeting card (here, not a bank card)
words.exampleMeaning: I wrote a congratulations message in the card.
Next Friday is my younger sibling's birthday.
My older sister graduates from university this year.

words.meaning: to pick, to choose (e.g. a gift)
words.exampleMeaning: What would be good? Please help me choose.
I got flowers for my birthday.

words.meaning: to like (something you got or see)

exercises: Choose the right word (선물 / 꽃 / 카드): ① 엄마 방에 예쁜 ____을 놓았어요. 매일 물을 줘요. ② ____에 '항상 고마워요'라고 썼어요. ③ 친구 생일 ____로 지갑을 샀어요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 포장하다: 이 컵은 친구 선물이에요. 예쁘게 ____ 주세요.
Choose 골랐어요 or 받았어요: ① 백화점에서 한 시간 동안 아빠 선물을 ____. ② 어제 친구한테서 생일 카드를 ____.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 졸업하다 (present tense): 오빠가 내년 2월에 고등학교를 ____.
Put the words in order to congratulate your sister: 축하해요 / 언니, / 졸업
Your friend gave you a hat and asks: 이 모자, 마음에 들어요? You like it. Answer in Korean.
answers: ① 꽃 ② 카드 ③ 선물
언니, 졸업 축하해요. (Also correct: 졸업 축하해요, 언니.)
네, 마음에 들어요. (Also correct: 네, 정말 마음에 들어요.)
